questions.question: There are 6 consecutive integers and 5 consecutive integers. The average of the 6 integers is 2 less than the average of the 5 integers. The sum of the 5 integers is 4 more than the sum of the 6 integers. Find the average of the 6 integers.
questions.questionHtml: There are 6 consecutive integers and 5 consecutive integers. The average of the 6 integers is 2 less than the average of the 5 integers. The sum of the 5 integers is 4 more than the sum of the 6 integers. Find the average of the 6 integers.
questions.solution:
• Let average of 6 = a, average of 5 = b

• a = b - 2 (average of 6 is 2 less than average of 5)

• Sum of 5 = 5b, Sum of 6 = 6a

• 5b = 6a + 4 (sum of 5 is 4 more than sum of 6)

• Substitute a = b - 2: 5b = 6(b-2) + 4 = 6b - 12 + 4 = 6b - 8

• 5b - 6b = -8 → -b = -8 → b = 8

• a = 8 - 2 = 6

• Answer: 6

questions.question: Two distinct grades of rice, one priced at Rs.80 per kilogram and the other at Rs.120 per kilogram, are amalgamated in an undisclosed proportion. The resultant blend is retailed at Rs.132 per kilogram, securing a profit margin of 20% on the overall cost price. Determine the precise ratio in which the two rice varieties were intermingled.
questions.questionHtml: Two distinct grades of rice, one priced at Rs.80 per kilogram and the other at Rs.120 per kilogram, are amalgamated in an undisclosed proportion. The resultant blend is retailed at Rs.132 per kilogram, securing a profit margin of 20% on the overall cost price. Determine the precise ratio in which the two rice varieties were intermingled.
questions.solution:
• Find CP of mixture:

• SP = Rs.132, Profit = 20% → CP = 132/1.2 = Rs.110/kg

• Allegation: Rs.80 and Rs.120 mixed to get Rs.110

• Cheaper to mean: 120 - 110 = 10

• Costlier to mean: 110 - 80 = 30

• Ratio = 10:30... wait: ratio of cheaper(80) : costlier(120) = (120-110):(110-80) = 10:30 = 1:3

• Answer: 1:3 (Rs.80 rice : Rs.120 rice = 1:3)

questions.question: The area of a regular hexagon is made of how many equilateral triangles?
questions.questionHtml: The area of a regular hexagon is made of how many equilateral triangles?
questions.solution:
• Regular hexagon geometry:

• A regular hexagon can be divided into exactly 6 equilateral triangles.

• Each triangle connects the center to two adjacent vertices.

• All 6 triangles are congruent equilateral triangles.

• Answer: 6

questions.question: A circular fountain with a radius of 7 m is encircled by a grass bed that is 3.5 m wide. Determine the ratio of the area of the grass bed to the area of the fountain.
questions.questionHtml: A circular fountain with a radius of 7 m is encircled by a grass bed that is 3.5 m wide. Determine the ratio of the area of the grass bed to the area of the fountain.
questions.solution:
• Fountain radius = 7m; Outer radius (fountain + grass) = 7 + 3.5 = 10.5m

• Area of fountain = π × 7² = 49π

• Area of grass bed = π × 10.5² - π × 7² = π(110.25 - 49) = 61.25π

• Ratio = 61.25π : 49π = 61.25:49 = 245:196 = 5:4

• Answer: 5:4

questions.question: A tent designed as a triangular prism features a triangular base with an area of 20 m² and a height of 6 m. What is the volume of this tent?
questions.questionHtml: A tent designed as a triangular prism features a triangular base with an area of 20 m² and a height of 6 m. What is the volume of this tent?
questions.solution:
• Volume of triangular prism = Base Area × Height

• Base area = 20 m² (triangular cross-section)

• Height (length of prism) = 6 m

• Volume = 20 × 6 = 120 m³

• Answer: 120 m³

questions.question: Which line has slope -1 and passes through (2,3)?
questions.questionHtml: Which line has slope -1 and passes through (2,3)?
questions.solution:
• Line equation: y - y₁ = m(x - x₁)

• m = -1, point = (2, 3)

• y - 3 = -1(x - 2)

• y - 3 = -x + 2

• y = -x + 5

• Answer: y = -x + 5

Three non-overlapping, non-touching circles are drawn in a plane. What is the maximum number of distinct common tangents that can be drawn to them in total?
questions.questionHtml: Three non-overlapping, non-touching circles are drawn in a plane. What is the maximum number of distinct common tangents that can be drawn to them in total?
questions.solution:
• Common tangents between circles:

• Between any 2 separate circles: 4 common tangents each pair

• 3 pairs of circles: C(3,2) = 3 pairs

• Tangents per pair = 4

• Total = 3 × 4 = 12

• Answer: 12
